profile.name: Abraham Akinniyi O.
profile.availability: Open to MEP & electrical engineering roles
profile.headline: Electrical project execution, from installation to commissioning.
profile.intro: I support MEP projects through installation, inspection, testing, commissioning and quality control — keeping every electrical system safe, compliant and reliable.
summary: I am an MEP Project Engineer with hands-on experience supporting electrical project execution, installation, inspection, testing, commissioning, and quality control.

I am skilled in site coordination, technical documentation, troubleshooting, and ensuring compliance with engineering, safety, and quality requirements. With a strong foundation in electrical systems and project execution, I bring a practical, detail-oriented approach to delivering reliable engineering solutions.

competencies.title: MEP Project Execution
competencies.description: Supporting electrical installation, inspection, testing and commissioning across project sites.

competencies.title: Site Coordination & Supervision
competencies.description: Coordinating and monitoring electrical works on site alongside senior engineers and trade teams.

competencies.title: Technical Documentation
competencies.description: Preparing drawings, measurements, datasheets, quality records and project documentation.

competencies.title: Engineering Drawings Interpretation
competencies.description: Reading and applying engineering drawings to guide accurate installation on site.

competencies.title: Quality & Safety Compliance
competencies.description: Making sure work meets engineering, safety, quality and applicable industry standards.

competencies.title: Team Collaboration & Coordination
competencies.description: Working with production, technical and site teams to resolve issues quickly.

highlights: Support electrical engineering and project execution activities across project sites.
Assist with electrical installation, inspection, testing, and commissioning activities.
Participate in troubleshooting and identification of electrical installation issues.
Support site coordination and monitoring of electrical works.
Assist with technical documentation, drawings, measurements, and project records.
Ensure assigned activities comply with safety, quality, and engineering requirements.
Work under the supervision of senior engineers, continuously building practical knowledge of electrical systems, construction processes, and project execution.
Conducted quality inspections on raw materials and finished cable products, ensuring compliance with industry and international standards.
Performed cable testing to verify compliance with required technical and quality specifications.
Performed cable fault analysis using locator devices, reducing product failure rates and improving reliability.
Improved production quality by enforcing standardised testing procedures and quality benchmarks.
Developed and implemented technical datasheets, enhancing documentation accuracy and traceability.
Collaborated with production teams to reduce defects and improve overall process efficiency.
Utilised ERP systems to optimise inventory management and production planning workflows.
Monitored production processes and supported quality assurance and process improvement initiatives.

certifications.title: Graduate Member, Nigerian Society of Engineers (GNSE)
National Youth Service Corps (NYSC) Discharge Certificate

strengths: Strong attention to detail with a track record of maintaining high-quality standards.
Ability to work in fast-paced industrial environments with minimal supervision.
Committed to continuous learning and engineering excellence.
